keypoints.name: Inverted Pendulum Control
keypoints.description: The video demonstrates how to control an inverted pendulum, a classic control theory problem. It involves keeping a rod balanced upright using a stepper motor and feedback from an encoder.
keypoints.strength_reasoning: The inverted pendulum is introduced at the beginning, demonstrated throughout the video with code and hardware, and referenced at the end as a good learning project.

keypoints.name: PID Controller Tuning
keypoints.description: The video focuses on manually tuning a PID controller for the inverted pendulum.  It covers adjusting proportional, integral, and derivative constants (Kp, Ki, Kd) to achieve stable control.
keypoints.strength_reasoning: Tuning the PID is the primary practical task of the video; it's explained step-by-step with examples and graphs. The whole back end of the video is dedicated to this.
